answer: Voting power that vests with continuous account age, like pigment slowly seeping into karst limestone, makes fresh identities nearly weightless. Each key earns influence only after months of unbroken daily check-ins tied to a small saffron-coloured upkeep fee. An attacker running N fakes pays N fees every day for the whole vesting period and must keep every one alive, so cost grows linearly in heads and in time.
